name: Signal exposes its capture registry over authenticated HTTP
Discord exposes its capture registry over authenticated HTTP
Discord entry passes the actual producer registry
collector scrape configuration uses the effective API bearer
old:
- job_name: signal-bridge
        scrape_interval: 30s
        metrics_path: /metrics
        authorization:
          type: Bearer
          credentials: ${env:NORA_BRIDGE_API_TOKEN}
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - signal-bridge:18090
new:
- job_name: signal-bridge
        scrape_interval: 30s
        metrics_path: /metrics
        authorization:
          type: Bearer
          credentials: ${env:NORA_BRIDGE_TOKEN}
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - signal-bridge:18090

name: API override wins over legacy bearer in actual HTTP scrape
publisher metrics target is reachable on the collector network
